# Health screening

Health screening

Learn about health screening programmes and functional check-ups for the elderly.

[Screen for life (SFL)Get regular health screening with subsidised rates.](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/61/Screen_for_Life)[Project Silver ScreenGet a simple check-up for vision, hearing and oral health.](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/160/aap/functional-screening)

Vaccination

Protect your loved ones with recommended vaccination for seniors.

[COVID-19 vaccinationReduce your chances of infection, and prevent severe illness if infected.](https://www.vaccine.gov.sg/)[Recommended vaccinationGet recommended vaccines based on your age group and gender.](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/163/vaccinate)

Programmes for seniors

Explore activities and programmes for seniors to stay active, healthy and connected.

[AIC Wellness ProgrammeAccess activity resources to meaningfully engage and enhance the wellbeing of both well and frail seniors.](https://www.aic.sg/care-services/aic-wellness-programme)[Active ageing programmesStay healthy with free active ageing programmes near your home.](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/160/aap?utm_source=lifesg&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=fy22-hwp-launch)[National Silver Academy (NSA) CoursesShort courses and online learning for seniors aged 50 and above.](https://www.c3a.org.sg/all-courses)[Seniors Go DigitalLearn digital skills for messaging, e-services, payments and more.](https://www.imda.gov.sg/en/seniorsgodigital)[Be a Silver Generation AmbassadorSign up as a volunteer and make a difference in seniors’ lives.](https://www.aic.sg/community/silver-generation-office)
